decisions.reason: A specialized agricultural harvesting crate fits the firm's agriculture segment, and it is too early to withdraw it one year after launch, though its niche visibility carries some risk.
Foldable large containers are a core returnable packaging line with strong automotive and industrial demand, and the product has its own page.
Stackable crates are a staple of the portfolio, serving food, retail and pooling customers, so it is unlikely to be dropped this soon.
A medium-duty rackable pallet broadens the pallet range for warehouse logistics customers and needs more time to build volume.
The spill-retention pallet serves regulatory and safety needs, and it is promoted on its own page, which suggests the firm is committed to it.
A pallet with load retainers is a dedicated solution with its own page that fits the firm's engineered handling offering.
